items.label: Qnity Electronics press release: Qnity Introduces New Kalrez High-Temperature Sealing (10-06-2026)
items.signal_prefix: Qnity introduced Kalrez 7080 perfluoroelastomer parts, a sealing solution

set.figure: Kalrez 7080 engineered for processes up to 330°C; 672 hours at up to 325°C in internal evaluation

items.reason: The release never says the parts are 'rated' to 330°C; it says they are engineered for processes operating at temperatures up to 330°C.
